message.reasoning_content: User asks: "Name three primary colors." Simple factual. Need answer concise. Need consider primary colors can be RGB (red, green, blue) or RYB (red, yellow, blue) depending context. Common general answer: red, yellow, blue. Could mention depends: in light red, green, blue; in paint red, yellow, blue. Since asks three primary colors, likely expect red, yellow, blue. Keep concise.
